Which of the following years showed the highest growth rate in onshore production?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Growth in 2015 - 16 = 9.23 - 8.79 = 0.44

Growth in 2016 - 17 = 9.85 - 9.23 = 0.62

Growth in 2013 - 14 = 9.01 - 8.87 = 0.14

Growth in 2012 - 13 has been declined

**∴ Required answer is 2016 - 17**
